scientific_integrity: Exact combinatorial proof and reproducing checker supplied. Prior work already proves qualitative ring inefficiency and price of stability one; the new claim is the full resolved equilibrium census. Bibliographic incompleteness remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Only pure strict-improvement swap equilibria of two colors on a completely occupied simple cycle at symmetric preference peak one-half; not general networks, jump games or convergence. Finite enumeration checks but does not prove infinite claims.
title: Full equilibrium and integration census for single-peaked swap Schelling games on cycles
